description: Saskatoon Police hired 15 new recruits, including diverse members.
New recruits do not fully address police staffing shortages.
Transit policing initiative aims for nine dedicated officers by 2027.

chips.text: Chief McBride stated the police service is prepared to hire over strength for special constables.
Business owners along 8th Street corridor attended a Chamber of Commerce event.
Seven of 15 new recruits are visible minority, two are Indigenous/Metis.
Chief promised to prioritize exemplary recruits to avoid losing them to other services.

description: Police Truth, Reconciliation, Treaty Implementation project is 81% complete.
Long-serving officers and new recruits receive five-day Indigenous training.
New Indigenous training module planned for police promotion exams.

chips.text: Constable Shayna Lyndon developed the Indigenous training curriculum, now used by police colleges.
No specific recruitment target percentage for Indigenous members has been set yet.
Police will embed Indigenous-inspired displays within headquarters in public and secure areas.
